standard-dialogue.npc: Hello friend. I wish to slay evil and avail them of their loot! Take me to Burgh de Rott!

options.text: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?

steps.player: Are you prepared enough to fight the evil down there?

steps.npc: I think so? At least my heart knows courage and that should be sufficient for the meantime. I expect that when we get to Burgh de Rott, we'll be able to purchase suitable provisions.

steps.player: But you do realise that the vampyres in Morytania are immune to everything except silver?

steps.npc: Er...well, I've not heard mention of that fact, but I have faith that Saradomin will provide the means to furnish me with suitable weapons when I reach Burgh de Rott.

steps.player: And if we happen to run into some vampyres on the journey down there?

steps.npc: I trust that you will help us to avoid them. You are a guide after all, aren't you? Anyway, you look like you can handle yourself. I presume you've fought such creatures before and won? How hard can it be?

steps.player: It can be pretty difficult, actually. But you're right, I'll be your guide so I should be able to handle the situation.

options.text: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?

steps.player: Why do you want to go to Burgh de Rott?

steps.npc: I'm going down there to teach those vampyres a lesson or two. I've heard about the terrible conditions down there and I intend to put a stop to it.
I want to have a go at this Theatre of Blood everyone keeps talking about!

options.text: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?

steps.player: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Burgh de Rott?

steps.npc: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of enemies. You don't need to worry about that.

options.text: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.

steps.player: I can take you to Burgh de Rott.

steps.text: If the player has a follower:

steps.npc: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
Ok, which route should we take?

standard-dialogue-when-a-piece-of-accept.npc: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.

steps.npc: This place is a bit grim. How can people live here?
Do you visit Burgh de Rott often? You seem to know the route well.
When are we going to get to Burgh de Rott?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on. I have loot to get.
Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than the opulet life styles forced on us adventurer types. I'd much rather be up to my eyes in mud and having a good fight!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-during-com.npc: Can't you see I'm being attacked...

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-when-a-pie.npc: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-bridge-eve.npc: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Paterdomus. We can't get over that bridge!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-bridge-eve.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-bog-event.npc: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-bog-event.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-bog-event.npc: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
But we really should be heading off now.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-river-even.npc: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Paterdomus.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-river-even.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-river-even.npc: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-tentacle-e.npc: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-finishing-.npc: Many thanks for getting me safely to the Burgh de Rott. Here's your reward.

burgh-de-rott-ramble-dialogue-finishing-.text: The Adventurer gives you a reward token!
